'''Shu's father''' (Japanese: '''シュウの父''' ''Shū's father'') is a character from [[Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!]].

==History==
[[Shu]]'s father left home five years ago to try to capture {{p|Mew}}, but the adventure proved frivolous. He did not catch Mew, but he did capture {{p|Mewtwo}}. 

Shu's father is an accomplished inventor and is the creator of the [[Income]] device.

He wanted to name Shu ''{{p|Mew}}'', but [[Shu's mother|his wife]] decided against it.

Shu once claimed his father used him as bait for catching his Pokémon, made him pass an intelligence test at the same time as a {{p|Slowpoke}} and made him eat Pokémon food.
